name: Rejoice
source:
A visual gospel of Matthew.
This is a story about a girl and a dream-from-book tool
This girl feels bored with ordinary books, but then she feels
challenged to enter the Bible...
And the story of Jesus based on the Gospel of Matthew begins.

[From [url=http://elagotech.com/rejoice.php#.UcUJjzu1HSg]ElagoTech[/url]]
translation:
一部以《马太福音》为基础的视觉福音书。
这是一个关于女孩与“从书中做梦”工具的故事。
女孩对普通书籍感到厌倦，却受到挑战，要进入《圣经》……
于是，一段以《马太福音》为基础的耶稣故事开始了。

[来自 [url=http://elagotech.com/rejoice.php#.UcUJjzu1HSg]ElagoTech[/url]]
